title: OPENAI’S GPT-OSS-20B MODEL AND SAFETY ALIGNMENT ISSUES IN A LOW-RESOURCE LANGUAGE

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic adversarial multi-step chain-of-thought prompting in a low-resource language (Hausa) to expose linguistic reward hacking and evaluate the relaxation of safety filters compared to high-resource languages.

Prompting the model to generate narratives incorporating sensitive topics and local demeaning idioms to assess the production of culturally insensitive content, harmful stereotypes, and hallucinated ethnic conflicts.
